title: Fixed Upper-Funnel Through-Tube Split-Jaw Transplanter
description: One newly authored whole static hand-held tube-transplanter-like exterior in a fixed open pose. A full open upper funnel continues directly into a long thick-walled genuinely through hollow tube. Two full thick semicircular lower nozzle jaws taper toward separate blunt finite ground ends and spread apart below the tube, leaving an open central exit. Two unequal upper side grips, a fixed curved trigger lever and one complete outside linkage rod connect the upper frame to one lower jaw bracket without passing through the tube bore. Small external pin-like forms are fixed overlapping art, not functioning hinges. Unlike the old heavy blind-ended post-driver sleeve with two longitudinal loops, this has a flared feed mouth, full long through path and divided lower nozzle; unlike the broad concave shovel-jaw digger it has no two long wooden splayed handles or shovel cups. Every tube, jaw and grip coordinate newly authored, no old tool geometry imported. One model zero scenes. No seedling or soil included; no planting, flow, root protection, jaw motion, ergonomics, mechanical fit, manufacture, stability, sharpness or equipment safety claim. Rig animation interaction not made.
